name: Total Euler Characteristic (TEC)
aliases: Total Euler Characteristic as a Noise Measure
definition: A noise level estimation for direct volume rendering transfer function design, defined as the L1-norm of the evolution curve of the Euler Characteristics for all possible isovalues.
summary: Total Euler Characteristic is a noise metric for volume rendering that distinguishes true topology from speckles by measuring the L1-norm of Euler characteristic evolution, outperforming gradient-based measures.
